references.label: Orbit advance spinner
references.description: Right spinner used to advance Orbit lamps; each full revolution lights one Bonus lamp.
references.context: Repeat the right spinner while its return remains safe.

references.label: Orbit lamps
references.description: Ten center lamps advanced by the spinner, bumpers, rollovers, and selected targets to add bonus units.

references.label: Bonus collect rollunder
references.description: Upper-right gate that awards and resets the built bonus before serving a new plunge.

references.label: Vari-target
references.description: Center-left target whose deepest level advances bonus and lights Double Bonus.

references.label: Right-outlane gate
references.description: Gate opened by the left inlane; a lit right-outlane escape can award the current bonus.

references.label: Advance Bonus skill-shot lane
references.description: Center lane in the upper-left group that advances bonus on the plunge.
